verdict.rationale: Mailgun publishes a first-party MCP server, documented at its own docs site and confirmed by a probe. It lets any MCP-capable AI assistant manage the account conversationally: sending emails, checking delivery stats, managing domains and troubleshooting DNS. Missing for 10: installation, auth and transport details in the evidence, a full tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Mailgun MCP Server lets you manage your Mailgun account through natural language using any AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
you can ask your assistant to send emails, check delivery stats, manage domains, troubleshoot DNS, and more — all conversationally.
